value.rationale: This natural first non-nearest-neighbor modular hard-core constraint yields an unbounded, exactly counted family of entropy-maximizing ergodic measures, with a sharp mod-3 bifurcation and one possible half-period spectral anomaly. The same infinite family has an exact gcd-sensitive periodic-point function, including the striking absence of nonzero periodic points at all periods coprime to m despite positive entropy. These are complete dynamic invariants of the entire family, not arbitrary individual finite computations; their dynamical content is not supplied by the known general graph coefficient alone.
